7478.text: 7478 plays a brisk, front-foot game: above the midpoint on the matchup board, sharp of step, and steady as the field toughens. Their exchange rate in real fights runs above the middle; the lifetime kill count climbs above the middle too. The edge wears thin against the hardest third, and the headshots sit below the middle — a card still writing its story.

7722.text: 7722 is the matchup board's surprise: above average where the fights are real, fast, and holding firm as the opposition strengthens. The lifetime IvI line sits near the bottom, a stark contrast that says the long view misses something the matchups catch. Headshots stay rare, accuracy ordinary, yet the results keep landing above average.

77769777.text: 77769777 plays a cool, efficient game: rating, tempo, bravery, resistance — the whole adjusted card sits in the upper tier, as the matchup kill-death mark answers in kind. Accuracy runs top-shelf while the headshot share stays middling, so the kills come from clean body shots and calm positioning. The lifetime IvI sits above average, a touch below the matchups.

7oro.text: 7ORO has been fighting since 2014, and the aim is still the story: accuracy near the top, with every matchup line — rating, activity, bravery, resistance — sitting above the middle. Headshots land mid-pack, one notch under the accuracy, and the lifetime IvI line tracks the matchups. The edge stays solid against the strongest third — a veteran's card built on sharp, steady shooting.

77cn.text: 77CN plays the patient game to perfection: a resistance that ranks in the top tier, and a lifetime kill-death record to match. The tempo stays unhurried, and the matchup record runs well above average. A steady regular who lets the fight come and makes every shot count.
